en: List the document-level components hanging off the catalog dictionary (ISO 32000-2 §7.7.2, Table 29) — the parts of a PDF that are not page content and that page-oriented readers drop: bookmarks, layers, attachments, the XMP packet, and the actions that run when the document is opened.
Absolute path to a local PDF file (e.g., "/path/to/document.pdf")
How many outline (bookmark) items to list. The count and depth are always computed over the whole tree.
Return the XMP packet text itself (capped at 64 KiB). Off by default: the declared values are extracted either way.
Output format: "markdown" for human-readable, "json" for structured data
